ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light-grey) central pixels to 15% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) peripheral and focal pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity central region; continuous low-intensity perimeter banding (5-15 pixel width) along trailing edges; discrete low-intensity focal blobs at relative coordinates [0.38, 0.65] and [0.49, 0.72] of the visible fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 118 degrees; depth is roughly 4% of total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, stochastic serration pattern with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels across the continuous linear boundary between the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the central notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved trailing points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity focal clusters (5-7 distinct nodes) localized in the lower-central and lower-left ventral quadrants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct diagonal linear disruption (dark pixel track) approximately 40 pixels in length on the lower right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular dark cluster at the peduncle-notch intersection; asymmetrical raggedness and tissue loss at the distal-most points of the lateral tips.
